Version 1.0.1

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Trimmed and focused the description to highlight key use cases (user profile, influencer data, blogger analysis).
- Clarified login handling: now prompts the user for action if login fails, instead of terminating automatically.
- Updated pagination instructions to always confirm the max page count with the user.
- Adjusted batch orchestration recommendations: suggest multiple browser sessions for higher throughput, but only with user approval.
